name: colorful-body
description: Colors headings, bold text and inline code in assistant replies

links.title: Links
links.description: Make URLs, [label](url) links and path-looking inline code clickable (OSC 8 hyperlinks). Off by default: where the terminal is not detected as supporting them (herdr, for one), Claude Code draws the text followed by the URL. Turn on in a terminal that supports OSC 8, with FORCE_HYPERLINK=1 if it is not detected.

frame.title: Prompt frame
frame.description: Draw your own prompts in a right-aligned frame.
